name: Verify Horizon Fleet Services Customer Account Creation
description: Ensures Horizon Fleet Services has been created as an active customer in the account table.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE name = 'Horizon Fleet Services' AND account_type = 'customer' AND active = 1;

name: Verify Horizon Field Response Coordination Group Creation
description: Confirms the "Horizon Field Response Coordination" group exists as an active field-type user group.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group WHERE name = 'Horizon Field Response Coordination' AND type = 'field' AND active = 1;

name: Verify Manager 518 is Assigned to Horizon Field Response Coordination
description: Ensures that user 518 is a member of the "Horizon Field Response Coordination" group.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member ugm JOIN user_group ug ON ugm.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE ug.name = 'Horizon Field Response Coordination' AND ug.type = 'field' AND ugm.user_id = 518;

name: Verify Manager 518 is Removed from Field Service Coordination_3
description: Confirms that user 518 is no longer a member of the "Field Service Coordination_3" group after the move.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 54  AND user_id = 518;
